purpose: A model-blind calibration may freeze the numeric fixture coordinates, relation-region margins, neutral-start checks, and artifact hashes needed to define future one-factor confound levels. It is not model inference or behavioral evidence.
freeze_requirement: After model-blind calibration, publish a new hash-pinned amendment/registry containing the observed numeric coordinates and margins, one named factor and its numeric levels, control/intervention allocation, and randomized pair manifest before any confound model request.
